name: SIGMA-PPG
subfield: Self-supervised / representation learning for sensing signals (PPG bio-signals)
capability_it_enables: Self-supervised PPG foundation model using a Prior-Guided Adversarial Masking mechanism; pretrained on 120,000+ hours of photoplethysmography, it produces general representations that beat five SOTA baselines across 12 downstream health tasks. Pretrained checkpoints released on HuggingFace.
verbatim_quote: Pre-trained on over 120,000 hours of data, SIGMA-PPG achieves superior average performance compared to five state-of-the-art baselines across 12 diverse downstream tasks.

name: PulseLM
subfield: Self-supervised / representation learning for sensing signals (PPG bio-signals + language)
capability_it_enables: Multimodal framework pairing PPG signal encoders with LLMs for physiological-signal reasoning; ships a large PPG-text QA dataset (1.31M 10s segments, 3.15M QA pairs across 12 clinical tasks), training/eval code, and model checkpoints + dataset on HuggingFace.
verbatim_quote: PulseLM is a multimodal framework that integrates PPG (Photoplethysmography) signal encoders with large language models for physiological signal understanding research.

name: SAM-Audio (Segment Anything in Audio)
subfield: Self-supervised / representation learning for sensing signals (audio)
capability_it_enables: Diffusion-transformer foundation model (Meta) for general audio source separation that unifies text, visual, and temporal-span prompting in one framework; isolates any sound in a mixture. Code installable via pip and checkpoints (sam-audio-large) released on HuggingFace.
verbatim_quote: SAM-Audio is a foundation model for isolating any sound in audio using text, visual, or temporal prompts.

name: Woosh (Sound Effects Foundation Model)
subfield: Self-supervised / representation learning for sensing signals (audio)
capability_it_enables: Sony AI sound-effects foundation model bundling a high-quality audio encoder/decoder (Woosh-AE), a text-audio alignment model (Woosh-CLAP), and text-to-audio + video-to-audio generative models, including distilled fast-inference variants. Inference code and open weights released.
verbatim_quote: This repository provides inference code and open weights for the sound effect generative models developed at Sony AI.

name: Audio-Omni
subfield: Self-supervised / representation learning for sensing signals (audio)
capability_it_enables: End-to-end framework unifying understanding, generation, and editing across general sound, music, and speech; couples a frozen Qwen2.5-Omni MLLM with a trainable Diffusion Transformer, plus a new 1M-pair AudioEdit dataset. Code on GitHub and model checkpoint on HuggingFace.
verbatim_quote: the first end-to-end framework to unify understanding, generation, and editing across general sound, music, and speech domains.

name: Sparse-BitNet
subfield: Efficient / on-device / small models (extreme quantization + sparsity)
capability_it_enables: Training/inference framework that combines 1.58-bit (ternary) BitLinear quantization with N:M structured sparsity, showing 1.58-bit LLMs are naturally friendly to semi-structured sparsity for efficient on-device LLMs. Runnable train.py / eval.py / generate.py provided.
verbatim_quote: Training framework for Sparse-BitNet models -- combining 1.58-bit quantization (BitLinear) with N:M structured sparsity for efficient LLM training and inference.

name: Agent Memory Below the Prompt (Persistent Q4 KV Cache)
subfield: Efficient / on-device / small models (edge KV-cache quantization)
capability_it_enables: Persists each agent's KV cache to disk as 4-bit quantized safetensors and reloads it directly into attention, eliminating redundant prefill for multi-agent LLM inference on edge devices; cuts time-to-first-token by up to 136x and fits 4x more agent contexts in fixed memory vs FP16. Open-source code for Apple Silicon.
verbatim_quote: Persistent KV cache for multi-agent LLM systems on Apple Silicon.

name: EEG-DLite
subfield: Efficient / on-device / small models (data distillation for efficient sensing-model training)
capability_it_enables: Dataset-distillation framework that encodes EEG segments into compact latent representations and filters out noisy/redundant samples, enabling more efficient pre-training of large EEG foundation models on a smaller curated subset (AAAI 2026). Runnable distillation + LaBraM pretraining scripts.
verbatim_quote: EEG-DLite is the first systematic framework for pre-training data distillation in EEG foundation models.
